title: G10/G11/G22: independent access negatives and audit/retrieval limitations
public_pr_body:
Adds nine independent access-boundary tests; 9/9 pass on committed reviewer code 09cb1258. The pinned-candidate baseline passed 280 tests across 14 files. Original complete logs, failure attempts, SQL manifests, UTC/exit/environment/commit and log hashes retained.

Production enrolment is not MFA enforcement: actual named access list, per-company/server MFA settings and departed-session checks remain unverified. Audit source and latest-25 versus filtered/per-record views reviewed; actual audit-chain/retention preservation checks need the full identified stack and approved schedule. Historic invoice/signature/older-audit/excluded-SliQ timed retrieval not executed: no approved archive/sample supplied. Full-stack registry-policy failure retained, not called a pass.

No claim that unit doubles prove production access or actual historical retrieval. Handover: tests/reviews/b5-g10-g11-g22/B5-G10-G11-G22-REVIEW.md.

- [x] Separate owned reviewer branch; original failures retained; source/lint/type/whitespace checks scoped in report. Raw logs kept byte-for-byte, including original whitespace.
- [ ] Independent owner assessment, actual final-candidate runtime evidence and authorised acceptance remain open.

Explicit Rhys overnight allocation. New b5 test/tool/review files only; no Claude-owned source/test edits, #359 branch modification, ISO pack work, Ready label, main merge, production migrations/wipe/import/counter change, deployment, live AI/automated email or message to John. PRs targeting #359’s branch are review follow-ups only; no merge is requested. Production actions remain subject to Rhys’s separate approval.
